title: Move the Arcadia pointer to test-transient-review-retry-after-exhaustion (press AFTER the first-unattended-run amendment, BEFORE the next-run Grant)
problem: PROJECT.md and the Plan point at first-unattended-run, which is outside the next-run Grant's scope. If production is activated like that, the scheduler moves the pointer to test-transient-review-retry-after-exhaustion itself with a commit on the local main checkout that no pull request reviews; it then sits in the next candidate's base and breaks that PR's 'touches only' criterion (Process Critic pre-mortem, 2026-10-19).
desired_effect: Through the canonical arcadia advance queue make-next (preview, then apply with that exact fingerprint) move both current_action pointers from first-unattended-run to test-transient-review-retry-after-exhaustion, and publish that one make-next commit to origin/main with a normal push, so production starts with nothing to re-point.

does: Runs only when launched through the operator-action library, with its script and descriptor tracked and unmodified at the main checkout's HEAD, until 2026-10-26

Requires main clean and level with origin, the Plan active, production Inactive, both pointers on first-unattended-run, and first-unattended-run already depending on the three next-run Actions (the accept-first-unattended-run-depends-on-next-run-actions-20261019 amendment on main)

Previews make-next for arcadia/test-transient-review-retry-after-exhaustion at the current queue revision, requires exactly first-unattended-run -> test-transient-review-retry-after-exhaustion at main's HEAD, applies with that fingerprint, and checks the commit touches only PROJECT.md and the Plan
Pushes that one commit to origin main without force and confirms origin carries it; a press after a failed push publishes only that exact recognised commit
never_does: Settle or amend any Ask, Action, Decision or queue order, or edit a document by hand
Activate production, start or stop a Session, restart a service, or force-push

success.effect: PROJECT.md and the Plan name test-transient-review-retry-after-exhaustion on origin/main; first-unattended-run waits for the three next-run Actions.
success.next: Press grant-production-unattended-claude-next-run-20261019 when ready. Each Action's completion then advances the pointer inside its own pull request.

failure.effect: Before the apply nothing changes. After the apply, an unconfirmed push leaves the pointer commit on local main only.
failure.next: Read the failure handoff. Fix the named condition (press the amendment card first if it says so) and press again; do not press the next-run Grant while origin/main still points at first-unattended-run.
